record_title: Connected mutual visibility of rook graphs and the Zarankiewicz number
limitations: The exact identity reduces the general value to z(m,n;2,2), which remains open. The explicit q+binom(p,2) regime does not resolve the remaining Zarankiewicz cases, and higher-dimensional Hamming graphs are not covered. Bryant--Fu (2002) was inspected only through bibliographic and abstract material; it may contain the elementary saturation connectivity observation, though it predates the connected mutual-visibility invariant. Finite computation supports but does not replace the proof. No independent validation is asserted.
